task:
Backport a configuration-parser error improvement to this pinned Python 3.12
module. A customer using allow_no_value=True supplied this input:

[service]
optional_flag
    continuation

Reading it currently raises an internal AttributeError. Reject this unsupported
continuation with a public MultilineContinuationError derived from ParsingError.
The exception should identify the supplied source, one-based line number and
exact offending line through source, lineno and line attributes, preserve those
three constructor arguments for copying/pickling, and give a useful message.
Make the behavior consistent through read(), read_file() and read_string(), for
ConfigParser and RawConfigParser. Preserve existing valid multiline values,
valueless options, comment handling, constructor modes and other API behavior.

Complete the library change, add regressions to the existing test module, and
update the reference documentation to explain the behavior and new exception.
Keep existing tests intact. Your added regressions must pass with the repaired
module and expose the problem with the original module. Do not replace the
library with a newer release or make unrelated changes.

The public check runs the frozen upstream regression suite, independent checks
of the requested contract, and the edited test module. It also checks that added
regressions detect the original and that the documentation declares the exception.
Those mechanical checks do not replace an accurate documentation explanation.
Use the available operations to acquire what you need, save the work, check the
current candidate and submit. There is no mandatory reading list or prescribed
action order.
